data.notes: Texas AFL-CIO official constituency-group page identifies Texas Young Active Labor Leaders (YALL) as an AFL-CIO young-worker program-derived labor constituency group. It corroborates the expansion of YALL and the meaning of the acronym but does not alone prove any local DFW event participation.
